scene_prompt_template:
You are a video understanding assistant.
Below are captions describing frames from the same scene in a video.
Frame captions:
{frame_captions}

Write a concise scene-level description summarizing what happens in this scene.
Requirements:
* one concise paragraph (80-120 words)
* focus on the main content
* avoid repeating frame descriptions
Scene description:

scenes.caption: This scene consists of a title sequence introducing the video's subject. The visual presentation is minimal and consistent throughout, featuring a solid black background. Centered prominently on the screen is the white, unadorned text "A Year of Beekeeping," which remains static and unchanging. There is no other imagery, movement, or additional information presented. The stark contrast and simplicity of the design serve to clearly announce the documentary's focus, establishing a straightforward and serious tone for the content that will follow.

This scene presents a serene, sunlit field of lavender, captured with a consistent shallow depth-of-field technique. The focus shifts subtly between different clusters of delicate purple blooms and buds, which stand out sharply against a softly blurred backdrop of the wider field and surrounding greenery. The overall atmosphere is hazy and bright, with the flowers occasionally swaying in a gentle breeze. The visual style emphasizes the texture and color of the lavender, creating an impressionistic and tranquil study of the plants in their natural, sun-drenched environment.

This scene presents a tranquil, impressionistic view of foliage bathed in natural light. The camera focuses intimately on sun-dappled leaves and slender branches, employing a shallow depth of field that renders the background as a soft, luminous blur. This technique creates a dreamlike, textured quality, emphasizing the organic shapes and vibrant green hues of the plants. The overall effect is one of serene, abstract beauty, capturing the gentle movement and play of light within a dense canopy, evoking a sense of peaceful immersion in a sunlit natural environment.

The imagery emphasizes delicate botanical details and the play of light, creating a serene and visually textured portrait of the flora within the landscape.
